title: CPU loss at peak: Dave's playbook, verified by Maria, v3

body.title: CPU loss at peak
body.tip: The noon statement batch $STMT1 on CPU 5 is safe to suspend during peaks; resume after 13:00.
steps: Find batch work on the hottest survivor
Add static servers on the least-busy CPUs
Never reload the CPU yourself; call hardware support

claims.statement: On peak days the noon statement batch $STMT1 is safe to suspend between 11:00 and 13:00; resume it with ACTIVATE after 13:00.
claims.author: Dave

claims.statement: After losing a CPU at peak, add ATM-AUTH static servers on the least-busy CPUs before touching MAXSERVERS.
claims.author: Dave
